items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: He play (inaudible) in my band. He stay with my band about five, six years, play well.

ctx.x: So every night he used to come and look for me around my house, spend all kind of hours talking about this and that, everything. So I went with Don Redmon. I started with Don -- (Side 2.)
Then Doc Cheetam is the first trumpet player (inaudible). So he got sick. They had a big production, and they needed somebody to come in there and (inaudible).
